cases.mechanism_detail: A ~3-kb retrotransposal insertion of tandemly repeated sequence in the FCMD 3'UTR is carried on 87% of Japanese FCMD chromosomes on a common founder haplotype; the abstract does not name the element class or describe the mechanism (study is a haplotype-based age estimate).
cases.quote: In Japan, 87% of FCMD-bearing chromosomes carry a 3-kb retrotransposal insertion of tandemly repeated sequences within the disease gene
